intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Bailee steps onto the back porch. The backyard feels… extra twinkly today.

intro.speaker: Bailee
intro.text: Okayyyy… why does the air feel like it’s fizzy? Mira, ¿qué es eso?

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: Three Wonder Sparks are hiding nearby. Find them to unlock the shed.

snackCooler.speaker: Snack Cooler
snackCooler.text: Pssst. I can talk. Also: do you have any grapes?

windChimes.speaker: Wind Chimes
windChimes.text: Ting-a-ling! A secret breeze says: you’re doing great.

windChimes.speaker: Bailee
windChimes.text: That… was actually very sweet. Gracias, chimes!

shedLocked.speaker: Bailee
shedLocked.text: The shed lock is glowing. It wants… a puzzle?

shedUnlocked.speaker: Shed
shedUnlocked.text: Click—clack. Welcome, Bailee. You found enough Wonder Sparks.

shedUnlocked.speaker: Bailee
shedUnlocked.text: Okay… that’s DEFINITELY not normal. Let’s peek inside!
